basic_info.description: Nestled between Ashbury Heights and Cole Valley, this inviting 1 BD condo combines classic charm with modern convenience. Filled with natural light, the home captures sweeping western views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Marin Headlands, Sutro Tower, and Cole Valley. Period details and rich hardwood floors add warmth to a layout designed for both comfort and functionality. The spacious kitchen features abundant storage, stainless steel appliances, and room to customize to make it your own. Part of a boutique 4 unit building, the unit offers privacy, shared laundry, and 6 months of complimentary leased parking in the attached garage. Just blocks from Cole Valley's shops, cafs, and restaurants, and close to Haight-Ashbury, Golden Gate Park, UCSF Parnassus, and public transit, this home provides a rare chance to enjoy a vibrant neighborhood setting with spectacular views.
